titulo: A file name that says what it is
caption:
A file name that says what it is

Four files called final, and nobody knows which one. This one got a name that says what it is.

Renaming takes ten seconds, and it ends the hunt for the real one.

For whoever names the file for what it is, not final_v7.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table and a big computer screen on the right that shows a file called final_v7, and a bubble that asks which one is final. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes walks up from the left, its eyes go wide, it leans in and the file name on the screen changes to dec-report. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me naming it for what it is.
